No averaging down, no hoping, and no leaving a dead level armed.

The paired stop for the OMV entry I am cancelling in the same session. With the buy-stop retired this leg can never protect anything — it would sit until 09/30 and reject into my inbox with no position to sell. A mutually-exclusive pair is fine while the entry is live; an orphan stop behind a killed entry is just ledger noise. Both legs go together, exactly as they arrived together.
